title: Conformal Selection for Hierarchical Streaming Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.26328v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many real-world tasks involve making sequential decisions about whether to select candidates before their responses of interest are revealed. In this work, we address the online selection problem in the context of hierarchical data, where candidates arrive sequentially from different populations. This extends existing online conformal selection frameworks beyond the standard i.i.d./exchangeable data assumption. The primary challenge lies in constructing valid statistics for each candidate sequentially under the hierarchical data structure. To this end, we first develop Online Hierarchical Selection (OHS), a distribution-free method that enables principled candidate selection for hierarchical data streams. Specifically, we introduce methods to construct rank-based e-values for both between-group and within-group samples, and apply averaged e-values to the online e-BH procedure. translated_title: 分层数据流的保形选择
translated_abstract: 许多现实世界的任务需要在感兴趣的结果被揭示之前，对是否选择候选对象做出序贯决策。在这项工作中，我们研究了分层数据背景下的在线选择问题，其中候选对象依次来自不同的总体。这将现有的在线保形选择框架扩展到了标准的独立同分布/可交换数据假设之外。主要挑战在于如何在分层数据结构下为每个候选对象序贯地构建有效的统计量。为此，我们首先开发了在线分层选择（OHS），这是一种无分布方法，能够对分层数据流进行有原则的候选选择。具体而言，我们提出了为组间和组内样本构建基于秩的e值的方法，并将平均e值应用于在线e-BH程序。随后，我们开发了带反馈的OHS（OHSF），该方法利用反馈信息提升了选择的性能。
tldr: 该论文提出了面向分层数据流的无分布在线保形选择方法OHS及其带反馈变体OHSF，通过构建组间和组内的基于秩的e值并结合在线e-BH程序，将在线保形选择框架扩展到超越独立同分布/可交换数据假设的分层结构场景。
en_tdlr: This paper develops distribution-free online conformal selection methods, OHS and its feedback-enhanced variant OHSF, for hierarchical streaming data by constructing rank-based e-values for between-group and within-group samples with the online e-BH procedure, extending conformal selection beyond the i.i.d./exchangeable data assumption.
